# Task Completion Checklist

Use this checklist before marking any task as complete `[x]`.

## Pre-Completion Verification

### Code Implementation
- [ ] Code is written and compiles without errors
- [ ] All sub-tasks are complete
- [ ] No TODO or FIXME comments remain (or documented in issues)
- [ ] Code follows project style guidelines

### Testing
- [ ] Unit tests exist (if applicable)
- [ ] Integration tests exist (if applicable)
- [ ] E2E tests exist (if applicable)
- [ ] All tests pass locally
- [ ] Manual testing performed (if UI/UX involved)

### Documentation
- [ ] Code comments added for complex logic
- [ ] README updated (if needed)
- [ ] API documentation updated (if needed)
- [ ] CHANGELOG updated (if needed)

### Verification
- [ ] Feature can be demonstrated working
- [ ] Implementation matches requirements
- [ ] No known bugs or issues
- [ ] Code is committed to version control

## Evidence of Completion

**Commit Hash**: [e.g., abc123f]

**Files Changed**:
- [ ] List all files modified/created

**Tests Added/Modified**:
- [ ] List test files and test names

**Test Results**:
```
[Paste test output showing passing tests]
```

**Manual Testing**:
- [ ] Describe manual testing steps performed
- [ ] Include screenshots if UI-related

**Verification Command**:
```bash
# Command to verify this task is complete
# e.g., pnpm run test:e2e -- --grep "copyQueueUrl"
```
